title: mike-evidence-queue-and-risk-notes-2026-04-15
content:
Context: quick personal working list for SOC2 evidence triage + vendor checklist. Not an official doc — rough ordering, time-boxed tasks, and short notes for handoff.

Today (2026-04-15) goals:
- Clear the top-3 evidence gaps for VendorOps review (aim: 90m)
- Draft an ask to infra for S3 retention proof (15m)
- Quick micro-eval of new vendor questionnaire answers (30m)

Priority queue (highest -> lowest):
1) Vendor: Acme-Auth (priority: high; risk: P1) — missing encryption config snapshots, only have policy doc. Action: request KMS key arn + IAM policy snapshot. Time estimate: 45m. Slack thread: #vendor-acme-auth (see pinned messages). Jira: SEC-482.
2) Evidence: S3 retention proof for customer-audit (priority: high; risk: P0) — infra says retention policy applied but no object-level metadata. Action: ask infra for aws-cli listing command + example object metadata, or a short script to export timestamps. Time estimate: 15m. Jira: INFRA-1297.
3) Vendor: LoggingOps partner (priority: medium; risk: P2) — deliverable: signed DPA + SOC2 subprocessor list. Confirm legal has the latest DPA (ver 2.1). Action: ping Sabrina (legal) and add to evidence bucket if obtained. Time estimate: 30m.
4) Policy TODO: Data classification doc — sketch a one-pager for eng to review. Keep it super concise (what, where, who). Time estimate: 60m (defer if blocked).

Quick vendor checklist (fast checklist I copy-paste when triaging):
- DPA signed? (yes/no; date)
- Subprocessors listed? (Y/N)
- Encryption at rest described? (AES-256 / KMS)
- Key material control (customer-managed KMS?) (notes)
- Access logs available (CloudTrail/ELB/other)? (where)
- Retention policy documented and demonstrable? (CLI example requested)
- Relevant certs (ISO/SOC) + report ID? (attach if available)

Notes on evidence mapping (how I plan to structure S3 evidence bucket):
- /evidence/vendor/<vendor-name>/agreements/ -> DPA/contract PDFs
- /evidence/vendor/<vendor-name>/config-snapshots/ -> iam-policy.json, kms-key.txt, s3-bucket-policy.json
- /evidence/systems/<system-name>/ -> retention-export.csv, object-listing-sample.txt

Commands / quick snippets to request from infra (copy into Slack):
- aws s3api list-objects-v2 --bucket redwood-production-customer-a --query "Contents[?LastModified>\`2025-01-01T00:00:00Z\`].[Key,LastModified]" --output text | head -n 50
- aws iam get-policy --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:policy/RedwoodVendorAccess --output json > iam-policy.json
- aws kms describe-key --key-id alias/my-vendor-key --output json > kms-key.json

Mini-eval rubric (how I score vendor evidence quickly):
- Completeness (0-3): docs + configs + demo artifacts.
- Freshness (0-2): evidence < 12 months preferred.
- Demonstrability (0-2): can produce CLI output / screenshots within 24h.
- Legal status (0-2): signed agreements present.
Total max: 9 (>=7 good, 4-6 follow-up, <=3 high risk)

Open questions / to escalate:
- Do we accept vendor self-attestation for logging retention if they show CloudTrail config but no object-level proof? (ask legal & compliance lead)
- For Acme-Auth KMS, do we need cross-account access logs or is key arn + policy sufficient for SOC2? (raise on SEC weekly)

Handoff notes (if I get pulled into incident):
- If someone else owns, assign backup: Jin Park.
- Place any obtained PDFs in evidence bucket path above and add a short README.txt explaining source + timestamp.

Personal timing plan for today:
- 09:00-09:30 — Acme-Auth initial Slack + compile missing list
- 09:30-10:15 — Request infra S3 retention snippet + follow-up
- 10:15-10:45 — Quick review Acme-Auth responses (score using rubric)
- 11:00-12:00 — Draft one-pager data classification (first pass)

Quick links / refs:
- SOC2 evidence playbook: confluence: SOC2 evidence playbook (CONF-2234)
- Vendor intake form (template): https://redwood.internal/forms/vendor-intake
- Slack search: "from:acme-auth has:link" (helps find previous threads)

Last-minute thoughts / TODO seeds (brain dump):
- Build a tiny Lambda that exports object metadata for a sample prefix -> make infra run on request (would save repeated manual requests).
- Add a note to playbook about acceptable evidence formats (csv/cli/json/screenshots).
- Consider a monthly sweep script to validate evidence freshness for top 20 vendors.
summary: Personal working queue for SOC2 evidence triage and vendor checks; includes prioritized tasks, quick checklist, CLI snippets, rubric, and handoff notes.
